type_definitions.name: ReleaseEvidenceReviewRequest
type_definitions.description: Release identity, asserted notes, and the policy used to assess their support.

fields.name: release_id
fields.description: Stable identifier of the software release whose claims are assessed.

fields.name: asserted_notes
fields.description: Individual release-note claims presented by the source project.

fields.name: support_policy
fields.description: Project rule specifying what counts as explicit support for a claim.

type_definitions.name: ReleaseEvidenceReviewReport
type_definitions.description: A defeasible separation of supported and unsupported release-note claims.

fields.name: release_id
fields.description: Stable identifier carried from the assessed release request.

fields.name: supported_claims
fields.description: Release claims for which the supplied notes state policy-adequate support.

fields.name: unsupported_claims
fields.description: Release claims lacking support under the supplied project policy.

fields.name: follow_up_recommendation
fields.description: Recommended evidence-gathering action, distinct from observed support.

workflows.description: Assess the explicit evidential support for claims in one software release.

asserted_notes: The new cache reduces median response latency.
fixture.support_policy: A claim is supported only when the notes identify a test, measurement, or compatibility check.

epistemic_contract.subject: The explicit support supplied for claims in software release v2.4.0.
epistemic_contract.question: Which release-note claims satisfy the project's stated support policy?
observations: The supplied release notes are assertions and do not by themselves constitute verification evidence.
defeaters: A referenced test may be irrelevant, incomplete, stale, or unavailable for inspection.
epistemic_contract.defeater_rationale: The review preserves these limitations instead of converting textual support into proof.
epistemic_contract.output_meaning: A generated and defeasible classification of claims under the supplied policy.
epistemic_contract.assurance_justification: The model performs an evidential critique; it does not execute or certify the referenced tests.

steps.description: Separate supported and unsupported release claims under the stated evidence policy.
steps.granularity_rationale: The source exposes one independently reviewed support assessment and no separately consumed epistemic intermediate.
steps.reasoning_rationale: The operation compares each assertion with explicit support while retaining defeaters.

skills.contribution: Applies the project's support criterion and separates observations from recommendations.
